text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally here! Oguri Cap versus Super 
Creek! I've been waiting to see these two 
in a race together!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, Creek, Inari One, and Mejiro 
Ardan... Who's gonna win this...!? Ahhh, I 
just can't wait for the race to start!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii! Prove that you're the strongest!! 
Don't lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Finally, a direct showdown with Oguri 
Cap and Super Creek all together. A major 
showdown that will decide the hierarchy.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Give me more, Inari One! I know you can 
make the Twinkle Series—and this entire 
era—so much more exciting!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa~, what an uproar! I hope Inari-chan 
isn't getting nervous.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Inari-chan'll be just fine! She's 
definitely gonna run proud and steal the 
show at this Autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Big Sis...! We're all 
cheering for you...!!"

The decisive showdown for Umamusume of the 
Year. Heading into the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
for a direct clash against Oguri Cap and 
the others, Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ââWell, we've finally made it here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I don't pull off a total victory 
against Oguri and the others today, the 
"top" is only gonna get further away.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I have to win here... No 
matter what...!

If I were to tell her right now, "You can 
win, Inari One," would that truly 
encourage her heart?

Inari One, who raced in the Mainichi Okan, 
knows better than anyone the true extent 
of Oguri Cap's strength, who she will soon 
face.

Which is why... I cannot simply offer easy 
words of comfort. All I can say is—
choice_data_list:
Let's give it everything we've got—hold 
nothing back.

text_block_list.text:
Ashamed that these were the only words I 
could muster, I spoke them from the very 
bottom of my heart, directly, hoping they 
would reach Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Why do you look like you're about to 
cry? You're the one who got me this far, 
partner. It's all thanks to you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"So, stand tall and proud. 'Cause I'm... 
gonna hold my head high too!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it everything I've got, every 
last bit. And then――"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat Oguri and the rest and seize the 
path to the top!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: âI'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The whole paddock feels stifling. I can't 
even tell if I'm breathing—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be damned. To think that back 
during the Mainichi Okan actually looks 
cute compared to this...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Meeting on the racetrack like 
this... it's been since last year's Arima 
Kinen, hasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Creek... You're incredible today. You've 
grown even stronger since that time."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That goes for Oguri-chan too, right? I've 
been looking forward to running with you 
for so long~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Today, I will be the one who wins.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of yielding. The one 
who wins will be me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Holy smokes...! The two of you standing 
side by side is quite a magnificent 
sight...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I gotta beat those guys. And thoroughly 
enough that anyone can see I'm on top... 
absolutely perfectly...!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Inari-chan.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Yo, Creek. Looks like you're in top 
form.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to today, 
thinking I'd finally get to race alongside 
you in the Senior Class, Inari-chan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Let us compete with everything we've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
With me, Inari-chan, and Oguri-chan. In 
this Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Just what I was hopin' for!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I know I can do it...! Everyone... 
Boss...! They all believe in me...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I know I can do it...! Everyone... 
Sis...! They all believe in me...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get your head in the game, Inari One...! 
This is the watershed moment, the climax 
of the grand brawl!!
